evidence: Quality Gates and Release run 35365728267 successfully verified live Render staging search before the later capacity stage failed.

The staging journey queried /api/v1/courses/?search=acceptance and asserted that the representative acceptance-capacity-mathematics course was returned; the backend regression suite also verifies relevant published search/filter results.

criteria.name: Checkout communicates every state
evidence: Quality Gates and Release run 35365728267 completed the real staging checkout/status journey before the later capacity gate failed.

The staging-only OIDC acceptance flow created a pending PayFast sandbox checkout, verified pending status with no enrollment, completed a synthetic verified payment without a real charge, then verified paid status, active enrollment, and a populated paid_at timestamp.

criteria.name: Delayed PayFast ITN is handled correctly
evidence: Payment Security run 35339900771 passed the deterministic PayFast security suite.

The suite proves a delayed verified callback within the configured replay window is accepted and fulfilled exactly once, while an expired callback is rejected before any gateway verification call; no real PayFast charge or live provider request is used.

criteria.name: Students cannot access another student's data
evidence: Live Supabase project epkcuseloinygkakxxdu has RLS enabled on public.student_profiles with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE ownership predicates based on auth.uid() = id.
A live authenticated cross-user test using a different synthetic UUID returned visible_other_profiles=0.

criteria.name: Protected content is never publicly cached
evidence: GitHub Actions Quality Gates and Release run 35344274130 passed the production worker protected-response cache-header test on release commit 179691dea3f6626d3f83f066991149e8e8c08a43.
The test verifies protected /checkout responses are private, no-store, max-age=0 with Vary: Cookie and confirms protected prefixes for dashboard, documents, checkout and auth-state handling.

criteria.name: Automated backups restore successfully
evidence: Backup Restore Verification run 35257412727 passed end-to-end using PostgreSQL 17, the exact recovery image, deterministic synthetic data, encrypted Restic backup, isolated restore, and integrity verification.

criteria.name: Load tests meet agreed thresholds
evidence: Quality Gates and Release run 35354817117 executed a controlled 100-user staging capacity attempt for 361.886 seconds with 1,905 requests, 0 request failures, and 0 server 5xx responses.

The strict capacity gate FAILED: p95 was 15,000 ms versus the 1,000 ms limit and p99 was 21,000 ms versus the 2,000 ms limit. Render metrics showed the free staging instance repeatedly reached its full 0.15 CPU limit while memory stayed below its 512 MB limit.

The same artifact exposed a distributed harness defect: target hold time was recorded as only 1.0 second and authenticated request classes were absent from the aggregated samples. A follow-up hardening change requires distributed user-count aggregation and authenticated dashboard/lesson/payment-status samples before future capacity evidence can pass.

criteria.name: Transactional email passes SPF, DKIM and DMARC
Errors are useful without technical disclosure
evidence: Live Staging Acceptance run 35339900772 passed against the deployed Render staging service.

HTTP 400/403/404/429/500 responses returned the correct status, Amaris branding and support correlation reference, and were checked for absence of traceback, Django secret, database URL and PostgreSQL connection leakage.

criteria.name: Monitoring captures failures without personal data
evidence: Render staging for commit 0345bfe99ce1f5a06068842c7c7c45fe6ea624a4 started with amaris_cms.workers.PrivacyUvicornWorker, which disables Uvicorn client-address access logging.

After the privacy worker became live, Render application logs captured cache failures, worker recycling, and a saturation-time CancelledError traceback without client IP addresses, query strings, authorization tokens, student email addresses, or other student identifiers.

criteria.name: Essential navigation and forms work without JavaScript
evidence: GitHub Actions Quality Gates and Release run 35344274130 passed the responsive browser suite with JavaScript disabled in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
The final no-JavaScript progressive-enhancement checks completed successfully as part of the 66/66 responsive/browser result on PR #41.

criteria.name: Monitoring and administration outages do not stop students
evidence: The Render staging inventory contains the application service, PostgreSQL, and a Redis broker/cache but no Flower, Grafana, Prometheus, or administration service required by the student request path.
Quality Gates and Release run 35354817117 completed the real protected checkout/status/progress/resume/lesson staging journey while optional monitoring/admin services were absent.

During the capacity window Render application logs reported Redis cache read/write failures and delayed cache invalidation, while the web service remained live and continued serving requests; cache failure degraded performance but did not become a student-access dependency.
